data.name: SchedulerDescription
data.value: Scheduler with its day, week and month views, driven by the page or by its own toolbar.

data.name: SchedulerSettingsDescription
data.value: The sample appointments always fall in the current week.

data.name: SchedulerViewDescription
data.value: The same value as the scheduler's own switch.

data.name: SchedulerCultureDescription
data.value: Sets the first day of the week, the day names and the date formats.

data.name: SchedulerTodayDescription
data.value: Brings the scheduler back to today after navigating.

data.name: SchedulerTimeGridDescription
data.value: The day and week views become a grid from 8 am to 6 pm, in 30-minute slots; turned off, they stay lists.

data.name: SchedulerMovableDescription
data.value: An appointment is dragged onto a slot or a day, or moved from the keyboard through its button; the page applies the reported move.

data.name: TimelineDescription
data.value: Timeline of dated entries: title, automatic or custom date text, entries without a header.

data.name: TimelineSettingsDescription
data.value: Each setting redraws the timeline below.

data.name: TimelineDateModeDescription
data.value: The date formatted by the component, a relative text, or no date at all.

data.name: TimelineLayoutDescription
data.value: Where the entries sit relative to the line: on its right, on its left, or taking turns from one side. Below 30rem wide, the entries stack on the right.

data.name: TimelineShowTitlesDescription
data.value: Without a title nor a date, an entry has no header at all.

data.name: TimelineNewestFirstDescription
data.value: Reverses the order of the entries.

data.name: TimelinePreviewHint
data.value: The last entry is dated in the future.

data.name: GanttDescription
data.value: Gantt chart: tasks on a time scale, grouped or not, with their progress, their dependencies and the today line.

data.name: GanttSettingsDescription
data.value: The sample project always starts two weeks ago, so today falls inside it.

data.name: GanttScaleDescription
data.value: One column per day, per week or per month; the same value as the chart's own picker.

data.name: GanttScalePickerDescription
data.value: Shows the day, week and month picker above the chart.

data.name: GanttGroupsDescription
data.value: Lists the tasks under their group, each group with a bar spanning its tasks.

data.name: GanttDependenciesDescription
data.value: An arrow from the end of a task to the start of the task that waits for it.

data.name: GanttTodayDescription
data.value: A dashed line down today's column.

data.name: GanttPreviewHint
data.value: The chart scrolls sideways when the zoom makes it wider than the card; the task names stay in place.

data.name: StepTimelineDescription
data.value: The steps of a run on one time axis: where the run spent its time, which steps overlapped, and which never started.

data.name: StepTimelineOutcomeDescription
data.value: A finished run, a run still going, or a run whose tests failed.

data.name: StepTimelineElapsedDescription
data.value: For a run still going: the instant it is looked at, which the running steps reach.

data.name: StepTimelineSecondaryDescription
data.value: Prepare and Cleanup, set in italics.

data.name: StepTimelineNeverStartedDescription
data.value: Named under the bars rather than drawn: they took no time.

data.name: StepTimelinePreviewHint
data.value: Green succeeded, red failed, blue still running, grey skipped or cancelled; the duration of each step is on the right.

data.name: StepTimelineSettingsDescription
data.value: A pipeline run, as a continuous integration server draws them.

data.name: SchedulerPastSlotsDescription
data.value: Hatches what is already over: the slots of the time grid and the days before today.
